followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain three successive legal phases of Russian-national entry restrictions, not blanket closure of all Estonia–Russia travel. The August Estonia-issued-visa rule and September broader short-stay-visa rule differ in cohort. Family, transport, work/study and other listed exceptions remain; the January amendment alters diplomatic permission. Retain August18–September19,2022(32days), September19,2022–January25,2026(1224days), and the successor confirmed at January25 with no numeric duration. These are legal boundaries and not reopening dates. The original order cites aggression against Ukraine; the official legal text and government explanation support the qualified security/interstate framing, without inferring private intentions. Original one-page order and ministry body were read; the official amended order remains indexed access after JavaScript-only direct responses. ERR is a separate report of the cabinet announcement, not enforcement observation. All three phases remain unlocated legal layers with null coordinates. No nationwide sealed frontier or gate-level enforcement is asserted.
